holderQuote: Durene yawned. She leaned against the wagon. Just for a second.
Durene jumped and sliced her hand with her kitchen knife. Ryoka hissed, but Durene waved her hand.
effectQuote: “It’s alright! Didn’t even get through the first layer of skin!”

holderQuote: Her voice ended in a strangled noise as something hit her. Beza rose. Of them all, the Minotauress was fastest.
effectQuote: [Iron Skin]. [Haste]—she laid about her, knocking people off her feet. She grabbed Montressa and was covering Palt as he struggled to rise. Erin was surrounded. She felt someone yanking at her hair.

holderQuote: The half-Giant, adrenaline wearing off, covered in blood. Healed not at all by the blood he had spilled.
